jobs.title: Senior Cloud Solutions Architect (AWS)
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Cloud Solutions Architect to lead AWS migrations for enterprise clients. You will design landing zones with Terraform, plan database migrations using AWS DMS, and guide teams running Kubernetes. 8+ years of experience required. We offer visa sponsorship and relocation support for candidates moving to Germany, including EU Blue Card applications.

jobs.title: Cloud Migration Architect
jobs.description: Lead large-scale data centre to cloud migrations across AWS and Azure. Experience with AWS DMS, CDC pipelines and SQL Server to RDS migration is essential. We are a recognised sponsor with the IND and can support highly skilled migrant visa applications. Relocation package available.

jobs.title: Platform Engineering Architect
jobs.description: Design our internal developer platform on Kubernetes. You will own Helm charts, GitOps workflows and Terraform modules. Strong Go programming experience is a plus. Salary competitive. Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland; we are unable to sponsor work permits for this role.

jobs.title: DevOps Architect
jobs.description: Join our platform team as DevOps Architect focusing on Azure. You will standardise Azure DevOps pipelines and Terraform modules across 40 product teams. We welcome international applicants and help with relocation to Stockholm.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Manage a team of 8 cloud engineers running our AWS estate. Experience leading engineering teams, budgeting and FinOps practices required. Fluency in Danish is required for this role.

jobs.title: Azure Solutions Architect
jobs.description: Remote-first role (Finland-based) designing secure Azure landing zones for public sector customers. Security clearance may be required. Candidates must already hold EU work authorization.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Consultant
jobs.description: Advise enterprise clients on cloud strategy and modernisation across AWS and Azure. French or Dutch is an advantage. Competitive package.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description: Architect the hybrid infrastructure of a regulated financial services platform: on-premise Oracle estates, AWS, and PostgreSQL migrations. Visa sponsorship is available for exceptional non-EU candidates; we support work permit applications as a highly qualified worker (EU Blue Card).
